# A component with no state of its own that renders one with state, under a
# reactive `if`: an adapter over async.query, as `openapi:` writes one per
# operation (#298). One call site binds every two-way prop and the other
# leaves two to implicit state, as the Pokédex's do; either failed on
# bubbletea, and on android the page's own `pending` and `failure` named the
# wrapper's cells (android_child_var_named_like_root_runs.txt). bubbletea
# keeps no state of an instance's own, so the adapter has to be spliced where
# it is written, as the query in it is. It was built at run time instead,
# because the inliner asked only the adapter's own vars, funcs and lifetimes;
# the query was then spliced into the declaration, every function of which
# became a Model method -- a second `Model.__snglTeardown` beside the root's,
# and an effect settle reading cells no Model declared -- and the build
# failed. The Pokédex built only where a provider of `server` gave the adapter
# a var of its own.
#
# The other targets keep an instance's state and build the adapter at run
# time, which is what they are held to here.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func lookup(name string) async.Result[int] {
    return {ok=name.length()}
}

component lengthOf(name string, :value option[int] = null, :pending bool = false, :failure option[async.Failure] = null) ui.node {
    async.query(on=name, fetch=lookup, :value=value, :pending=pending, :failure=failure)
}

component lengths ui.node {
    var shown = true
    var name = "fig"
    var a option[int] = null
    var b option[int] = null
    var pending = false
    var failure option[async.Failure] = null
    if shown {
        lengthOf(name=name, :value=a, :pending=pending, :failure=failure)
        lengthOf(name="apricot", :value=b)
    }
    ui.button #grape(text="grape", @click { name = "grape" })
    ui.button #toggle(text="toggle", @click { shown = !shown })
}

func testEachAsksForItsOwn(t test.Test, c lengths) {
    t.assert(c.a == 3)
    t.assert(c.b == 7)
    c.grape.click()
    t.assert(c.a == 5)
}

func testAskedAgainWhenShownAgain(t test.Test, c lengths) {
    c.toggle.click()
    c.grape.click()
    t.assert(c.a == 3)
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.a == 5)
}
